rule: lowest WER with RTF <= 0.5 (else lowest RTF); long-form WhisperPipeline, greedy (num_beams=1), word_timestamps=True, no prompt

GPU.export: optimum-cli export openvino --model openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo --task automatic-speech-recognition-with-past --weight-format fp16 <model_dir>

alternative.why: fastest cell within 0.5 WER points of the pick

NPU.export: optimum-cli export openvino --model openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo --task automatic-speech-recognition-with-past --weight-format fp16 <model_dir>

CPU.export: optimum-cli export openvino --model openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo --task automatic-speech-recognition-with-past --weight-format fp16 <model_dir>

alternative.why: fastest cell within 0.5 WER points of the pick

cuda_baseline.note: measured while the NVIDIA GPU was power-capped (P5, SW power cap, ~32 W, memory clock 810 MHz); the same GPU did RTF ~0.06 (large-v2) earlier the same day

merge_notes: pick the Intel iGPU by vendor 0x8086 (DEVICE_ARCHITECTURE / FULL_DEVICE_NAME), not plain 'GPU': OpenVINO also lists NVIDIA as GPU.1

always pass CACHE_DIR (data/models/openvino/cache/<device>-<model>-<precision>): NPU first compile 40 s (base) to 270 s (turbo) and 666 s (medium int8), cached 0.7-2.9 s; NPU int4 compile is very slow (turbo int4 > 15 min)
WhisperPipeline(path, device, word_timestamps=True) and generation config word_timestamps=True; glue word pieces without a leading space to the previous word before split_sentences
no word probabilities (low_conf_words empty), no no_speech_prob/avg_logprob (only remove_repeats applies), no VAD (cap word durations)
num_beams > 1 fails on GPU and NPU (greedy only); CPU supports beam search
streamer is called once per 30 s window (text only); StreamingStatus.CANCEL stops at once; killing the process frees the device immediately
initial_prompt applies to the first 30 s window only (same as faster-whisper with condition_on_previous_text=False); hotwords applies to every window
